title: Heroic Progression
description: Main raid night. Heroic Nerub-ar Palace progression. Flasks and food provided from guild bank. Be online 15 min early for invites.

title: Heroic / Mythic Prog
description: Second main raid night. We continue Heroic clears and begin Mythic progression on farm bosses. Consumables required.

title: M+ Push Night
description: Guild Mythic+ push night. Form groups in Discord and push keys together. Goal: everyone gets their weekly vault filled.

title: Alt / Fun Run
description: Casual alt run through Normal Nerub-ar Palace. Open to all guild members and friends. Bring your alts!

title: Guild Anniversary Event
description: Celebrating one year of Belligerent Fury! Transmog contest, mount parade, and dueling tournament with gold prizes.

title: Mythic Prog Trial Night
description: Extra prog night for Mythic Ulgrax. Trials and core raiders only. Bring your A-game and full consumables.

title: PvP Battleground Night
description: Rated Battleground premade group. Looking for all roles. Minimum 1800 CR preferred but not required for guild members.
